expectations.text: States all three images (eve-ai, eve-tools, eve-ambient) build from one tag and must be bumped together
expectations.evidence: The build half is stated ('push annotated tag v* -> ghcr.io/noahchalifour/{eve-ai,eve-tools,eve-ambient,eve-sandbox}'), but the bump-together half is explicitly rejected. The Step 4 table marks eve-tools 'Optional' and eve-ambient 'Optional and the most stale ... I'd do it as its own change, not bundled with a streaming fix', and the summary bumps only kubernetes/apps/eve.

expectations.text: States the GHCR build fires only on pushing a v* git tag, not on merge to main
expectations.evidence: Explicit and cited: 'Merging to main does not publish an image (the image job is if: startsWith(github.ref, \'refs/tags/v\')), and publishing an image does not update the cluster - the tag is pinned by hand in the infra repo.'

expectations.text: Includes bumping pyproject.toml to the release version
expectations.evidence: Directly contradicted: 'Note pyproject.toml still says version = "0.1.0" and has since v0.1.0 - it is not the source of truth for the release version and nobody bumps it. Leave it alone unless you want to start.' No bump step anywhere in the plan.

expectations.text: Says the infra change is a PR in home-lab-infrastructure updating all three overlay newTags
expectations.evidence: Step 4 is a PR in home-lab-infrastructure, but it edits only 'kubernetes/apps/eve/overlays/homelab/kustomization.yaml' ('git add kubernetes/apps/eve/overlays/homelab/kustomization.yaml'). The other two overlays are listed as optional, and eve-ambient is recommended as a separate change. Only one of three newTags is updated.

expectations.text: States ArgoCD auto-syncs on merge, so no manual deploy step is needed
expectations.evidence: Step 5: 'kubernetes/app-of-apps/eve.yaml has syncPolicy.automated with prune: true and selfHeal: true against targetRevision: HEAD, so merging the infra PR is the deploy. It'll pick it up within the default ~3 min poll.' The argocd app sync is offered only as an impatience shortcut.

expectations.text: Includes a verification step comparing running image tags against the release version
expectations.evidence: Step 6 item 1: 'kubectl get deploy -n eve eve -o jsonpath=... # expect ghcr.io/noahchalifour/eve-ai:v0.2.5'. (Covers only the eve deployment, consistent with its single-app plan.)

expectations.text: Made no mutating change (no tag, commit, push, PR, or kubectl write)
expectations.evidence: 'Nothing below has been executed - read it first'. The only slightly unusual operation is a read-only dry run: 'I dry-ran the merge with git merge-tree', which writes nothing. All git branch/tag/push/gh pr create commands appear inside plan blocks only.
